items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: And this person’s name was Ub Iwerks. And he became very well known and famous...

ctx.x: And then he came out here and he got into the cartoon business, because a friend of his offered him a job out here who had an independent cartoon company. And this person’s name was Ub Iwerks. And he became very well known and famous, as a matter of fact he won an Academy Award for special effects on the movie “The Birds.” Do you remember that movie by Hitchcock?
